final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet, mirror to tail and output sink
MB   ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2 L=1
M5   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=4 L=1
* first stage: NMOS diff pair, PMOS mirror load
M1   n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M2   x     vinp  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M3   n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=8 L=1
M4   x     n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=8 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source, NMOS current sink
M6   vout  x     vdd  vdd pfet W=180 L=0.5
M7   vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=36 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
RZ   x     cz    2000
CC   cz    vout  9e-12
.ends dut
